thesis: One exact conversation remains canonically addressable while signal extraction, human annotation, obligation state, response coverage, bot handoff and RETURN become unequal projections beside it.

source_model.identity: SHA-256 of exact pasted source text in browser
source_model.address: message id + clause id + exact character [start,end) range

projections: single-message SOURCE FOVEA with clause addresses
OBLIGATION LATTICE: ASK / PROMISE / DECISION / WAITING / CONSTRAINT / NOTE
response/handoff lane with explicit coverage state
source-bearing RETURN import/resume restores exact thread, human marks, states, response and coverage

provenance_classes.DERIVED: weak deterministic heuristic suggestion; confidence < 1; never human intent truth
provenance_classes.HUMAN: explicit authored mark at exact source range; confidence 1

laws: SOURCE THREAD != DERIVED SIGNALS != HUMAN MARKS != RESPONSE
EVERY PROMOTED COMMS ITEM RETURNS TO AN EXACT SOURCE RANGE
SESSION-ONLY BY DEFAULT; LOCAL PIN IS EXPLICIT

interaction.non_scroll_primary: whole thread is compressed into a horizontal spine; primary reading surface holds one addressed turn at a time
interaction.address_navigation: turn spine, previous/next keys, LOCATE from any signal
interaction.response_coverage: target signals then COVER / DEFER / REOPEN explicitly
interaction.bot_handoff: copy source-addressed agent packet; no summary-only handoff
interaction.return_resume: IMPORT RETURN restores a source-bearing comms-spine-return/v0.1 after a source/session switch; address-only receipts are deliberately not resumable

privacy.human_port_import: current HUMAN PORT text/JSON session object only

promotion_gate: core tests preserve exact source slices through parser/signals/RETURN
430×900 browser flow: demo → HUMAN mark → target ASK → draft → COVER → packet
no horizontal page overflow on phone-sized smoke
one real long messy chat: user can recover place and open obligations without reading a chapter-scroll transcript
at least one wrong derived suggestion can coexist with a corrective HUMAN mark without source mutation
non_goals: no LLM dependency for core usefulness
no replacement of HUMAN PORT, READFIELD, LACONIC, CONTINUITY or agent-router
next: Use one real long conversation, author/correct marks, draft a real response, cover/defer obligations, then decide whether COMMS SPINE materially reduces re-entry/obligation loss.

verification.phone_flow: 430×900 create → HUMAN mark → target ASK → draft → COVER → RETURN → source switch → resume PASS

changes: Added explicit OPEN-signal → Dayline handoff: prefer HUMAN-authored OPEN signal, otherwise preserve DERIVED origin visibly.
The handoff preserves source SHA, message/range address, signal kind, origin and text without transferring the full conversation.
Transport is session-local atlas-dayline-handoff/v0.1 and requires explicit ADD TO DAY; send authority remains absent.
